items.title: Bulgaria emerges as a surprise leader in Europe's quest for battery storage
items.author: Alex Lefkowitz, Angeliki Koutantou
items.creator: Alex Lefkowitz, Angeliki Koutantou
items.summary: As Europe grapples with high energy prices, supply concerns and the prospect that climate change will lead to ever hotter summers, Bulgaria's contribution towards a solution has won it the nickname the "Battery of the Balkans".
items.body:
As Europe grapples with high energy prices, supply concerns and the prospect that climate change will lead to ever hotter summers, Bulgaria's contribution towards a solution has won it the nickname the "Battery of the Balkans".
Helped by €700 million ($783.86 million) in European Union grants, the Black Sea country has doubled its battery capacity over the last year, allowing it to store solar energy produced in the day and release it during peak hours in the evening.
That enabled a significant rise in power exports that supplied neighbouring countries when heatwaves in July and August left national grids struggling to cope with demand.
"Battery storage is critical now. It’s not a nice to have, it’s a must have," said Nikola Gazdov, chairman of industry body the Association for Production, Storage and Trading of Electricity, or APSTE for short.
European Union countries have for years sought to develop battery storage to balance the intermittent nature of solar and wind energy.
Progress has been delayed by long waits for regulatory approvals and grid connections, although [USN:L6N42U0QP TEXT:"adoption is expected to pick up"], especially in Germany, the UK and Italy. The events of this year, when high energy prices have added to grievances that have provoked [USN:L1N4610U5 TEXT:"social unrest"] have focused minds further.
Success in storing power for when it is most needed helps to determine how much customers pay for electricity and to cushion the impact of the disruption linked to the US-Israeli war on Iran.
LEAP IN BULGARIAN POWER EXPORTS Bulgaria has only limited amounts of domestic oil and gas, and its electricity output is dwarfed by many other EU countries.
But it succeeded in increasing its power exports by 62% this year from last year, APSTE figures show, to 3.5 terawatt-hours after EU grants and regulatory changes helped to draw in private investment to its battery storage.
Its storage capacity is now around 6 gigawatts, up from 3 GW a year ago.
Some of the exports went to Romania, which was forced to shut a [USN:S8N3YR00M TEXT:"nuclear reactor"] in August after a drought that reduced the levels of the Danube River whose waters are used to cool reactor turbines.
Apart from the exports' value, the increase in battery power also helped Romania to maintain reservoir levels by reducing its need to use hydropower, traditionally used to meet peak demand.
Bulgaria has exported as much as 50,000 megawatt-hours of electricity per day, said Dimitar Zarchev, head of Central Dispatch Management at Bulgaria's Electricity System Operator.
"To put that into perspective, that works out to an average of around 2,000 megawatts flowing out of Bulgaria every hour — roughly equivalent to the output of the Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant.” The plant is located in northwestern Bulgaria.
BENEFIT GREATEST IN SUMMER The batteries are expected to have less impact in winter when reduced daylight hours mean less solar power.
Zarchev expects over the coming winter months that Bulgaria will have to rely more on conventional power plants than stored renewable power.
Further increases in battery storage also face other issues, including the need for Bulgaria to expand its grid.
The pace of the scale-up has also eroded some of the financial incentives that drew investors as price spreads have narrowed, reducing the amount of revenue to be made from the gap between the price when power is stored and when it is discharged.
"At some point, batteries may begin to cannibalise part of their revenues," Bulgaria's Energy Ministry said in a statement to Reuters. "It will then become even more important for them to participate not just in simple arbitrage between cheap and expensive hours, but also in balancing markets and system services".
BULGARIA OUTPACES GREECE Greece, known for its many months of sunshine, looked like a natural leader in the battery race.
While its solar capacity has grown significantly, more than tripling between 2020 and 2025, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency, its battery storage is lagging and the country depends on imported gas to meet peak evening demand.
Despite three rounds of auctions for standalone batteries since 2023, Greece only installed a first chunk in April. Total storage is expected to reach one gigawatt by the end of the year, a small fraction of Bulgaria's capacity, according to government figures.
Greek retail electricity excluding taxes and levies averaged €0.1967 per kilowatt-hour in the first half of the year, compared to €0.1117 for Bulgaria, data from the EU statistics service Eurostat showed.
The Greek energy ministry said in a presentation last month it was working to speed up storage with the help of EU funds to try to lower [USN:L6N4600MT TEXT:"energy prices"].
Officials have said another 5 GW of battery capacity is expected to come online by 2030, in addition to the GW expected to be online by the end of this year. For some that is not soon enough.
"If we had had those six gigawatts operating now, our power system would have been more balanced and this would have passed on to consumers," Manolis Karapidakis, the chief executive officer of the Greek association of power storage developers, told Reuters.
($1 = 0.8930 euros)

items.title: 韓国、北朝鮮に軍事会談を再提案　地雷爆発受け
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２３日 ロイター] - 韓国国防省は２３日、北朝鮮に軍事会談を改めて提案した。南北間の陸上境界線の正確な位置について合意し、偶発的な衝突のリスクを減らすことが狙い。

９月に非武装地帯（ＤＭＺ）で地雷が爆発し、韓国軍兵士が負傷したことを受けたもので、キム・ホンチョル国防政策室長が発表した。

北朝鮮軍は近年、南北を隔てるＤＭＺ内の軍事境界線付近で、軍用道路やフェンスの建設、地雷の敷設を進めている。

キム氏によると、北朝鮮軍の兵士はこうした作業の過程で軍事境界線を越えていたという。

国防省は２０２５年１１月にも、境界線の位置を巡る認識の相違を解消するため会談を提案したが、北朝鮮は応じていない。

韓国軍は、９月に兵士２人が重傷を負った爆発の原因となった地雷について、北朝鮮が軍事境界線の南側に埋設したものと断定。北朝鮮側はこれを否定している。

items.title: Saudi Arabia postpones UN data forum, Saudi statistical event to 2027
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics has postponed the United Nations World Data Forum and the Second Saudi Statistical Forum, previously scheduled for November 9 to 12, 2026, in Riyadh, to 2027, it said in a statement on Friday.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics has postponed the United Nations World Data Forum and the Second Saudi Statistical Forum, previously scheduled for November 9 to 12, 2026, in Riyadh, to 2027, it said in a statement on Friday.
The move follows Saudi Arabia's decision on Monday to delay its [USN:L6N46511F TEXT:"flagship investment conference"] to 2027, after deadly attacks in recent weeks linked to the widening Middle East conflict disrupted business activity. The Future Investment Initiative had been due to take place from October 26 to 29.
The authority said it postponed the UN data forum and the Saudi statistical forum to ensure broad international participation by speakers, experts and partners, and the delivery of an event that meets the expectations of the global data and statistics community.
Several other major events in Saudi Arabia, including [USN:L1N4600SG TEXT:"the Six Kings Slam tennis tournament"] and the World Rally Championship's Saudi Arabia round, have also been cancelled or postponed amid escalating attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis.
The US-Israeli war with Iran this year has disrupted the Gulf's events calendar, prompting the cancellation, postponement or restructuring of several conferences in the UAE and Qatar, which were more heavily affected by attacks than Saudi Arabia in the first part of the year.

items.title: US military bans BYD vehicles from strategic air base in Japan
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US military said on Friday it will ban vehicles made by Chinese EV maker BYD from an air base in Japan, saying their presence posed a security risk.
items.body:
The US military said on Friday it will ban vehicles made by Chinese EV maker BYD (002594.SZ) from an air base in Japan, saying their presence posed a security risk.
The ban will begin at the Kadena Air Base on Japan's Okinawa island on Monday, the Yonhap newswire reported earlier. The base is a major US air power hub on Japan's strategic southwest island chain running along the edge of the East China Sea.
"These vehicles present an unacceptable and unmitigable risk to our personnel and our mission," base spokesperson Lieutenant Colonel Alli Stormer said. She did not say what specific concern had prompted the commander to act against the Chinese electric vehicles.
BYD did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The Chinese company, which overtook Tesla as the world’s biggest seller of battery-electric vehicles in 2025, is expanding overseas, including in Japan. It launched its Racco electric minicar there in July as it seeks a foothold in a market dominated by domestic brands.
The Pentagon in June designated BYD, along with e-commerce firm Alibaba (9988.HK) , internet company Baidu and automaker NIO, as companies it believes support China's military. BYD rejected the designation and said it would pursue administrative and legal avenues to protect its interests.
China has imposed similar restrictions on Tesla vehicles. In 2021 it barred them from some government compounds due to security concerns over cameras installed on the vehicles. Beijing removed that restriction in 2024 after Tesla won an endorsement from the country's top auto industry association.

items.title: China's DeepSeek, MiniMax win approval for AI global use, state media-affiliated entity says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Major Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax have won state approval for global use of their AI models, according to a post on Thursday on a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster CCTV.
items.body:
Major Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and MiniMax (0100.HK) have won state approval for global use of their AI models, according to a post on Thursday on a social media account affiliated with state broadcaster CCTV.
In a separate social media post on Friday, the social media account, Yuyuan Tantian, said overseas internet users had also urged other Chinese open-source large language models to follow suit.
DeepSeek and MiniMax did not immediately reply to requests for comment.
China [USN:L1N46209C TEXT:"proposed"] export controls on 23 AI technologies on October 16, including those involving models, agents and computing clusters.
China's commerce ministry said then, though, that most AI technologies would remain exportable, with simplified licensing for open-source technology exports and Chinese companies operating their own computing centres overseas.
The proposed export controls cover overseas deployment of AI models containing restricted technology and were Beijing's latest move to limit the transfer of tools it views as vital to national security amid geopolitical competition with Washington.

items.title: Silver selloff seems overdone, says Mirae Asset Sharekhan; here's why
items.author: Praveen Singh
items.summary: The crude oil/silver ratio has fallen through the crucial support around 58, which means silver remains vulnerable to rise in oil prices.
items.body: Disclaimer: This article is written by Praveen Singh, head of commodities at Mirae Asset Sharekhan. Views expressed are his own. Readers' discretion is advised. Spot silver has been under tremendous pressure since it breached the crucial support around $58.60 on October 14. Numerous recovery attempts have been rebuffed around this level. The white metal fell more than $3 on October 22, losing 5.33 per cent to trade at $54.90, its lowest since July 17, as oil prices jumped.  Geopolitics and oilHighly volatile crude oil prices surged more than 3 per cent on October 22 on dwindling hopes of a US-Iran deal, as US President Trump denied talks with Iran. A drone attack on Aramco’s Shaybah field on October 21 killed two people, which amplified supply worries. Although crude oil flows through the Middle East have topped pre-war volumes, concerns over escalation of US-Iran tensions, steep crack spread, low SPR Reserves and lingering uncertainty over oil flows continue to support oil prices. Brent crude oil futures jumped to $112.68 on Thursday, the highest since May, and were up more than 3 per cent for the day.     ETFs and COMEX inventoryTotal known global silver ETF holdings rose to 805.76 Moz, the highest since March 25 as net inflows increased 5 Moz (65 Tons) since October 15. This is a healthy development for the metal as holdings had been hovering around 800 Moz in October, contrary to huge inflows into the gold ETFs. However, overall, ETFs currently hold 64 Moz (1991 tons) less silver, down 7.36 per cent YTD, as compared with the end of last year. ETFs have seen a net outflow of 26 Moz (809 tons) since the beginning of the Iran war. ALSO READ: Gold outlook bleak; avoid aggressive selling without stop loss: Analyst Registered COMEX silver inventory at 103.33 Moz is down ~49 per cent from the cycle peak of 201 Moz seen in September 2025. China’s silver inventoryShanghai Futures Exchange on warrant daily stock total stands at 1368 tons, down 8.25 per cent from the cycle peak of 1491 tons seen on September 30. However, silver stocks, as they surged sharply in the last seven months, are up 441 per cent from the cycle low of 252 tons reached on March 3.     One-month lease rateOne-month LBMA lease rate at 0 per cent shows ample float at the LBMA warehouses; hence, has bearish implications for the metal. India’s silver imports likely to riseIndia’s silver imports are expected to pickup after the government eased restrictions. Bloomberg reported traders and bank dealers have received quotas through permits covering up to 6000 tons of silver. These permits will be valid for six months. India had introduced new licensing requirements in May to restrict imports of the metal to cut down deficit. India imported 7000 tons of silver in 2025. As more metal gets imported into the country, silver premium has softened. US Dollar Index and yieldsThe US Dollar Index, which rose to 102.95 on October 14 in the wake of hotter-than-expected US CPI data for September, has been consolidating around in the 101.50-102 range. The Index, at the time of writing was hovering around 101.87, up 0.06 per cent for the day. US yields slid on Thursday. Two-year Treasury yieds were noted at 4.69 per cent, down 2.29 per cent for the day, and down 5.44 per cent from the cycle high of 4.94 per cent seen on October 14. 10-year yield was at 5.01 per cent, down over 2 per cent. October Fed rate hike probabilityTraders assign a probability of merely 7 per cent to the event of the Fed hiking rates at its October 28 meeting. OutlookCrude oil/silver ratio has fallen through the crucial support around 58, which means silver remains vulnerable to rise in oil prices. Although intrinsic fundamentals of the metal are not so encouraging, selloff in silver, as in case of gold, seems to be somewhat overdone as yields and dollar fell. Trend selling is weighing heavily on the metal. A decisive breach of support around $54.50 could take the metal to $48-$50 mark. Resistance is seen at $59.

items.title: Dax tiefer erwartet - Konjunktur und Frankreich im Blick
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Der Dax wird am Freitag der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Verlusten in den Handel starten. Sorgen über den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und steigende Ölpreise hatten die Anleger am Donnerstag verunsichert und den Index 1,1 Prozent niedriger bei 25.371 Punkten schließen lassen. An den US-Börsen setzte sich der Ausverkauf bei Tech-Aktien fort. Die Erleichterung nach starken Quartalszahlen von US-Technologiefirmen wie Meta und SpaceX verpuffte schnell, da die hohen Kosten für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) wieder in den Fokus der Anleger rückten. Auf die Stimmung drückten zudem erneute Turbulenzen am französischen Anleihemarkt.
items.body:
Der Dax (.GDAXI) wird am Freitag der Kursentwicklung an den Terminmärkten zufolge mit Verlusten in den Handel starten. Sorgen über den Technologiesektor, negativ aufgenommene Konzernbilanzen und steigende Ölpreise hatten die Anleger am [USN:L8N46828X TEXT:"Donnerstag"] verunsichert und den Index 1,1 Prozent niedriger bei 25.371 Punkten schließen lassen. An den [USN:L8N4682FJ TEXT:"US-Börsen"] (.DJI) (.SPX) (.IXIC) setzte sich der Ausverkauf bei Tech-Aktien fort. Die Erleichterung nach starken Quartalszahlen von US-Technologiefirmen wie Meta (META.O) und SpaceX (SPCX.O) verpuffte schnell, da die hohen Kosten für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) wieder in den Fokus der Anleger rückten. Auf die Stimmung drückten zudem erneute [USN:L8N4680NI TEXT:"Turbulenzen"] am französischen Anleihemarkt.
Am Freitag blicken Anleger weiter auf die Entwicklungen in Frankreich.
Die Ratingagentur Moody's überprüft die französische Kreditwürdigkeit. Eine Herabstufung könnte die Risikoaufschläge französischer Staatsanleihen weiter erhöhen und damit auch den Euro sowie europäische Banken belasten.
Zudem werden die Einkaufsmanagerindizes (PMI) für die Euro-Zone veröffentlicht. Besonderes Augenmerk dürfte auf den Ergebnissen für Frankreich liegen.
Auf der Unternehmensseite kommen die IG Metall und Volkswagen in Hannover zusammen, um den Zukunftstarifvertrag von 2024 zum zweiten Mal zu überprüfen.

items.title: Trump stuft Import von Windkraftanlagen als Gefahr für US-Sicherheit ein
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: US-Präsident Donald Trump hat den Import von Windkraftanlagen und deren Bauteilen als Bedrohung für die nationale Sicherheit eingestuft. Er verzichtete am Donnerstag (Ortszeit) jedoch vorerst auf neue Handelsbeschränkungen wie Zölle. Stattdessen wies er Handelsvertreter an, Verhandlungen mit den Partnerländern aufzunehmen und innerhalb von 180 Tagen Bericht zu erstatten. Weitere Maßnahmen könnten später folgen, teilte das Weiße Haus mit. Einer Untersuchung des Handelsministeriums zufolge gefährden die Anlagen die Sicherheit durch Cyberrisiken bei ausländischen Geräten, Störungen von Radarsystemen und eine zunehmende Abhängigkeit vom Ausland.
items.body:
US-Präsident Donald Trump hat den Import von Windkraftanlagen und deren Bauteilen als Bedrohung für die nationale Sicherheit eingestuft. Er verzichtete am Donnerstag (Ortszeit) jedoch vorerst auf neue Handelsbeschränkungen wie Zölle. Stattdessen wies er Handelsvertreter an, Verhandlungen mit den Partnerländern aufzunehmen und innerhalb von 180 Tagen Bericht zu erstatten. Weitere Maßnahmen könnten später folgen, teilte das Weiße Haus mit. Einer Untersuchung des Handelsministeriums zufolge gefährden die Anlagen die Sicherheit durch Cyberrisiken bei ausländischen Geräten, Störungen von Radarsystemen und eine zunehmende Abhängigkeit vom Ausland.
Trump bekräftigte in dem Erlass seine langjährige Kritik, dass Windenergie unzuverlässig sei und das US-Stromnetz belaste. Der Schritt geht auf eine im vergangenen Jahr eingeleitete Untersuchung der US-Regierung zu den Auswirkungen von Importen auf die nationale Sicherheit zurück. Zu den wichtigsten Lieferanten von Windkraftanlagen und Komponenten für die USA gehören, Daten der Denkfabrik American Action Forum zufolge, neben Mexiko und Indien auch europäische Länder wie Deutschland, Dänemark und Frankreich.

items.title: El terremoto en el Tíbet deja 16 fallecidos y 65 heridos
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El número de heridos en el terremoto de magnitud 7 que sacudió la región suroeste del Tíbet chino ha ascendido a 65, informó el viernes el gobierno local en una publicación en las redes sociales, mientras que el número de fallecidos se mantuvo sin cambios en 16.
items.body:
El número de heridos en [USN:L6N46815F TEXT:"el terremoto"] de magnitud 7 que sacudió la región suroeste del Tíbet chino ha ascendido a 65, informó el viernes el gobierno local en una publicación en las redes sociales, mientras que el número de fallecidos se mantuvo sin cambios en 16.
El terremoto, cuyo epicentro se situó en Nagqu, una ciudad de gran altitud y escasa densidad de población situada en el norte del Tíbet, es el más fuerte que ha sacudido China desde enero de 2024.
Más de 300 agentes de policía, entre ellos personal de tráfico y de policía comunitaria, fueron enviados al epicentro para llevar a cabo labores de rescate y ayuda de emergencia, informó el departamento de policía de Nagqu en otra publicación en la aplicación de mensajería WeChat a primera hora del viernes.
Los agentes enviados a la región evaluaron los daños en las viviendas y ayudaron a la población a trasladarse a lugares más seguros, indicó también la policía de Nagqu en la publicación de WeChat.
Un video publicado por la policía en Douyin, la aplicación hermana de TikTok, mostraba a los agentes cargando suministros en un camión en la oscuridad e inspeccionando un edificio y los escombros con linternas.
Más de 12.000 personas han sido realojadas de forma segura, según la agencia estatal de noticias Xinhua.
Los videos difundidos anteriormente por medios de comunicación oficiales locales mostraban a personas abandonando sus hogares y buscando refugio al aire libre o en sus vehículos aparcados en la calle. Un residente contó que se despertó por el fuerte sismo y que oyó cómo crujía la casa durante el temblor.
El Centro de Redes Sísmicas de China indicó en un comunicado que se habían registrado 413 réplicas.
En 2010, un terremoto de magnitud 7,1 sacudió Yushu, en la vecina provincia de Qinghai, causando la muerte de al menos 2.698 personas y dejando a casi 300 desaparecidos.

items.title: Indonesia energy ministry to consider additional quota for subsidised fuel as demand rises
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Indonesia's energy minister said on Friday that he was considering requesting an additional subsidised fuel quota for this year as consumers look for cheaper options.
items.body:
Indonesia's energy minister said on Friday that he was considering requesting an additional subsidised fuel quota for this year as consumers look for cheaper options.
The ministry is calculating a possible increase in the distribution of 90-octane gasoline, known as Pertalite, as buyers shift away from 92-octane fuel, which is not subsidised, Energy and Mineral Resources Minister Bahlil Lahadalia told reporters.
The additional volume and subsidy costs are still being calculated, he said.
The government has pledged to keep the subsidised fuel price unchanged until the end of the year.
The government has allocated 29.27 million kilolitres of Pertalite for distribution this year.
By August 20, 18.23 million kilolitres had been sold, data from downstream oil and gas regulator BPH Migas showed.
Since the price of non-subsidised fuel rose in early June, average daily consumption of Pertalite has been around 10% higher, BPH Migas data showed.
Indonesia's Ombudsman said earlier this month that [USN:L6N4620HD TEXT:"fuel supply disruptions"] have been reported across several provinces, including Bali, North Sulawesi, West Sulawesi, Southeast Sulawesi, West Papua, and West Kalimantan, with vehicle queues stretching to around 1 km (0.6 miles) in several locations.

items.title: William Hill owner Evoke's Q3 revenue falls on UK shop closures, unfavourable sports results
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British betting and gaming company Evoke on Friday reported a 2% fall in third-quarter revenue, on a like-for-like constant currency basis, weighed down by store closures and unfavourable sports results early in the football season.
items.body:
British betting and gaming company Evoke (EVOK.L) on Friday reported a 2% fall in third-quarter revenue, on a like-for-like constant currency basis, weighed down by store closures and unfavourable sports results early in the football season.
Here are some details:
The company, which owns betting brands such as William Hill, 888 and Mr Green, reported a revenue of £406 million ($543.51 million) for the quarter ended September 30
Sports outcomes that resulted in higher payouts to winning betters at the start of the football season trimmed revenue growth by about 1 to 2 percentage points year-on-year, Evoke said
In March, Evoke said it would [USN:L6N40J1FZ TEXT:"shut"] a number of betting shops following tax hikes announced last year
CEO Per Widerström said the closure of 270 shops over the past year "shows the real impact on jobs and livelihoods from higher industry taxation"
Evoke urged the UK government to carefully consider any further tax increases ahead of its upcoming autumn budget
The debt-laden company agreed to be [USN:L4N42D0H1 TEXT:"acquired"] by Greek lottery and gaming firm Bally's Intralot (BYLOTr.AT) in June
($1 = 0.7470 pounds)

items.title: Crude oil up 85% in 2026 poses threat to global economy; Brent may hit $120
items.author: Mohammed Imran
items.summary: Brent climbed back above $113 a barrel after a deadly drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field, highlights Mohammed Imran of Mirae Asset Sharekhan.
items.body: Disclaimer: Views and outlook in this report belong to the brokerages and analysts cited. They do not reflect the views of Business Standard. Readers are advised to exercise discretion. Mohammed Imran, research analyst, Mirae Asset Sharekhan Asian refining margines hit by higher Freights With no US-Iran deal in sight to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the rally in oil is ringing alarm bells across financial markets worldwide. Crude is up 85 per cent so far this year and 10 per cent in October alone, while spot Brent and Middle Eastern grades have held above $100 a barrel for two straight months, posing a threat to the global economy unlike any other. Brent climbed back above $113 a barrel after a deadly drone strike on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah field. Output there was not affected, but a separate attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam killed one person. US 10-year Treasury yield dropped 17 basis points in a single session to 4.96 per cent on 22 October, its first close below 5 per cent since 22 September, as a tech selloff drove investors into safe havens. Freight is eating Asian refiners Margins The crack spreads during July-September became a boon for Asian refiners which increased their throughput despite higher oil prices has they were able to offset with realization through exports to Europe and other geographies to benefit from the higher cracks margins, however the shortages of VLCC and other tankers has sent the shipping rates to sky high that has started to hurt the refinery margins  an Asian refinery running Middle East crude earned roughly $40 a barrel in gross margin, and about $36 of that went to the tanker. In January, the same Gulf-to-China voyage cost about $2 a barrel. March makes the contrast sharper: a $51 margin, $10 of freight, and $41 left for the refiner. The IEA uses about $36 a barrel, while a consultancy estimate published on 19 October puts freight at $33 and the refiner's share at $7. Which during July to September were around $20-25/b. China is already buying less. Its crude imports fell 21.5 per cent year on year in September as refiners drew down record stockpiles rather than pay up, and the industrial PMI breakdown shows inventories falling month after month. Q3 imports were down 29 per cent even though non-seaborne supply held flat. Russia's share rose to 27.4 per cent, and Sinopec now expects Chinese oil demand to fall 8.9 per cent this year. The IEA's October report notes that Asian margins on medium-sour crude turned negative in September. China's import cost rose just 33 per cent, to about 4,500 RMB/t, or roughly $87 a barrel. Even that figure is flattered: it includes the July ceasefire, when a lot of Iranian oil got out, and Q3 physical prices were well below recent levels. Gulf-to-China freight is normally far cheaper than shipping from the Americas, so Middle Eastern supply has clearly fallen sharply, and any claim that Gulf flows to China are near pre-war levels is hard to believe. Check - TOP GAINERS NSE | TOP LOSERS NSE  Indian refiners Delima The latest reports comes from the shipping’s trackers have shown increased shipments of Middle easter crude to Indian ports . Middle Eastern crude imports jumped to about 2.8 mb/d in September, the highest since February and back to pre-war levels, with Gulf oil making up about 54 per cent of total imports, up from 32 per cent in August. Russian imports fell about 14 per cent month on month to around 1.8 mb/d, cutting Russia's share to 33.5 per cent from 46.6 per cent as Indian refiners faced stiff competition from China. US crude, meanwhile, is losing ground in Asia. Leasing a tanker for the Pacific run now costs a record of almost $80 million, and Asian orders for November-delivery US crude have dropped roughly 50 per cent month on month to 24–26 million barrels. If that pace holds to the end of the month, it would be a seven-year low. US Weekly Crude Oil inventories This week's EIA data showed distillate stocks recovering from a record seasonal low, while gasoline inventories fell to their lowest level since 2014. Hurricane Isaias also cut US crude output by 0.4 mb/d. Gasoil and ULSD are both still near $200 a barrel. Globally, observed stocks edged down in September, as a 113 mb fall in onshore inventories more than offset a 103 mb surge in oil on water. That leaves global stocks 509 mb below pre-war levels. October 16 were US commercial crude oil stocks were -3.5 per cent below the seasonal 5-year average, gasoline inventories were -4.9 per cent below the seasonal 5-year average, and distillate inventories were -9.0 per cent below the 5-year seasonal average.  US crude oil production in the week ending October 16 fell sharply by -3.00 per cent w/w to 13.269 million bpd. What the Midterms Could Change With the US midterms set for 3 November, oil has turned into a political number. Gasoline is averaging $4.29 a gallon at US pumps and diesel $6.30, up more than $1.25 and nearly 75 per cent respectively from a year ago. Washington has leaned on temporary Russian diesel imports and a G7 release of 100 million barrels from emergency reserves, but we doubt these measures will bring prices down in the near term. In our view, an escalation would send Brent to test $120/b. A stalemate, by contrast, would keep WTI hovering around $100 and Brent anchored above $110, with refined products remaining tighter than crude. Any further strike on Saudi infrastructure would reopen the upside tail. So far, the global economy has absorbed the second-order effects of costlier crude, but at current prices, demand destruction is likely to set in over the coming months if the deadlock persists, although that is not our base case.

items.title: Saab-Le bénéfice dépasse les attentes au T3, porté par le réarmement
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Saab a annoncé vendredi une hausse supérieure aux attentes de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, le groupe suédois de défense et d'aérospatiale citant une forte hausse de ses ventes, alors qu'il continue de surfer sur la vague du réarmement mondial.
items.body:
Saab (SAABb.ST) a annoncé vendredi une hausse supérieure aux attentes de son bénéfice au troisième trimestre, le groupe suédois de défense et d'aérospatiale citant une forte hausse de ses ventes, alors qu'il continue de surfer sur la vague du réarmement mondial.
Le résultat d'exploitation du constructeur de l'avion de chasse Gripen a atteint 1,95 milliard de couronnes (175,72 millions d'euros), contre 1,37 milliard un an plus tôt, alors que les analystes interrogés par LSEG tablaient en moyenne sur 1,91 milliard.
"Les perspectives à long terme du marché restent favorables", a déclaré le directeur général Micael Johansson dans un communiqué. "Grâce à un portefeuille solide, un carnet de commandes record, une capacité de production en expansion et des investissements continus dans les capacités futures, nous sommes bien placés pour atteindre nos objectifs financiers", a-t-il ajouté.
Saab, qui fabrique également du matériel militaire allant des missiles et de l’électronique de pointe aux sous-marins, a indiqué dans un communiqué que son chiffre d’affaires à périmètre constant avait progressé de 30,6% par rapport à l’année précédente.
Déjà porté depuis plusieurs années par une demande en forte hausse, alimentée par le réarmement rapide d’une grande partie de l’Europe face à la guerre menée par la Russie en Ukraine, Saab a vu cette dynamique s’accélérer encore cette année avec une série de commandes majeures.
Saab, qui rivalise avec des géants comme Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) , Dassault Aviation (AM.PA) et BAE Systems (BAES.L) , a annoncé que ses prises de commandes avaient bondi de 216% sur un an au cours du trimestre, dont une commande ukrainienne d’avions de combat Gripen d’un montant de 24,6 milliards de couronnes suédoises.

items.title: Gold outlook bleak; avoid aggressive selling without stop loss: Analyst
items.author: Praveen Singh
items.summary: On October 22, spot gold prices fell through the support at $4066; thus, the metal moved out of its $4066-$4226 October range. The yellow metal broke below $4100 on surge in oil prices even as the ...
items.body: Disclaimer: This article is written by Praveen Singh, head of commodities at Mirae Asset Sharekhan. Views expressed are his own. Readers' discretion is advised. On October 22, spot gold prices fell through the support at $4066; thus, the metal moved out of its $4066-$4226 October range. The yellow metal broke below $4100 on surge in oil prices even as the dollar index and yields were largely subdued. Firming up of the dollar as the day wore on pulled down the metal further. As of Thursday night, spot gold was trading at $4037, the lowest since August 3. It was down 2.5 per cent for the day. Geopolitics and oilCrude oil prices surged more than 3 per cent on October 22 on dwindling hope of the US-Iran deal as the US President Trump denied Iran talks. A drone attack on Aramco’s Shaybah field on October 21 killed two people, which amplified supply worries. Although crude oil flows through the Middle East have topped pre-war volumes, concerns over escalation of US-Iran tensions, steep crack spread, low SPR Reserves and lingering uncertainty over oil flows continue to support oil prices. Brent crude oil futures jumped to $112.68 on Thursday, highest since May, and were up more than 3 per cent for the day.  ALSO READ: Crude oil up 85% in 2026 poses threat to global economy; Brent may hit $120   Gold ETFGold ETF flows remain quite encouraging. Total net global gold ETF holdings rose to 101.55 Moz, highest since July 2022, as ETFs recorded a net inflow of 0.68 Moz in October. ETFs’ holdings are now up 2.60 Moz (81 tons) YTD and up 0.63 Moz (20 tons) since the beginning of the Iran war on February 28. Data roundupThis week is light on the US data front. ADP weekly employment change data for the week ending October 3 came in at 18.5K as compared to 26K in the previous week. US housing data were disappointing. NAHB Housing Index fell from 32 in September to 29 in October -- lowest since 2012. Housing starts in September slumped from 1288K in August to 1221K (forecast 1305K), a six-year low excluding the May data. Similarly, pending home sales fell 7.3 per cent on the month in September versus the estimate of -0.5 per cent. Jobless claims rose from 7K to 303.K. Weekly jobless claims slid from 200K to 194K, while continuing claims rose from 1703K to 1728K. Overall, weekly job data remain healthy in ‘low hire, low fire’ scenario.  September Leading Index was steady against the forecast of -0.1 per cent. UK's employment report for September was mixed. Average weekly earnings slowed down from August. Earnings rose 3.7 per cent Y-o-Y versus the estimate of 3.8 per cent and prior 3.9 per cent. 3M-3M employment change at 102K topped the estimate of 5K, while 3 months unemployment rate edged lower from 4.9 per cent to 4.7 per cent (forecast 4.9 per cent). UK’s September CPI inflation were hotter-than-expected. CPI inflation rose 3.5 per cent Y-o-Y compared with the estimate of 3.4 per cent and 3.1 per cent prior, while it was up 0.4 per cent M-o-M versus the forecast of 0.3 per cent. The headline CPI reading is the hottest since October 2025. Core CPI rose 2.8 per cent Y-o-Y, in line with the forecast but hotter than the August reading of 2.6 per cent.  ALSO READ: Silver ETFs fall up to 5% as oil surge, inflation fears hit bullion markets US Dollar Index and yieldsThe US Dollar Index, which rose to 102.95 on October 14 in the wake of hotter-than-expected US CPI data for September, has been consolidating around in the 101.50-102 range. The index, at the time of writing was hovering around 101.87, up 0.06 per cent for the day. US yields slid on Thursday. Two-year yields were noted at 4.69 per cent, down 2.29 per cent for the day, and down 5.44 per cent from the cycle high of 4.94 per cent seen on October 14; 10-year yield was at 5.01 per cent, down over 2 per cent. October Fed rate hike probabilityTraders assign a probability of merely 7 per cent to the event of the Fed hiking rates at its October 28 meeting. World Gold Council’s researchAccording to Kavita Chacko, research head for India at the World Gold Council (WGC), domestic gold price discounts for gold narrowed sharply in October. Discounts dropped from an average of $66 per ounce in September to $8 as of October 16 on improving seasonal demand. Seasonal gold demand is gaining strength in annual festive and wedding period as recent decline in gold prices supports demand. Gold bar and coin demand has moderated this year on waning price momentum. Net ETF inflows rose to US $466.2 million in September, the highest in seven months and nearly 3 tons of gold were added to holdings during the month, taking the cumulative holdings to 124 tons. Central bank watchChina’s PBoC kept one-year and five-year Loan Prime Rates unchanged at 3 per cent and 3.5 per cent in its policy announced on October 20. The US federal Reserve will deliver its monetary policy on October 28. The European Central Bank will announce its monetary policy on October 29. It is widely expected that both the central banks will keep their respective rates unchanged. However, major focus will be on the Fed’s stance on future monetary policy meetings as investors gear up for a rate hike in December FOMC meeting, though the Fed Chair Warsh adhering to his policy of ‘no forward guidance’ will abstain from giving any clear signals.  UK Chancellor of the exchequer John Healey will present annual budget to the Parliament on October 28. The Office for Budget Responsibility will release its fiscal and economic forecasts the same day. Upcoming dataMajor US data on card in the near term include ADP weekly employment change (October 27), October Conference Board Consumer Confidence (October 27), September preliminary durable goods orders (October 27), new home sales (October 27), September Advance goods trade balance (October 28), September real personal spending (October 29), Q3 GDP and September PCE Price Index (October 29). Major Eurozone data include S&P Global Eurozone manufacturing, services and composite PMIs (October 23). UK's PMIs will also be released on October 23. Japan's September national CPI and October preliminary PMI data will be released on October 23.   ALSO READ: Silver slips below ₹2 lakh amid selling pressure; gold also declinesOutlookSharp decline in gold prices on October 22 came mainly on higher oil prices, which looks somewhat overdone as the US yields fell. In addition, weak US housing data and mounting fiscal and political worries in France and social protests in several European countries provide a supportive backdrop for the meta. It appears selloff intensified on momentum selling. Near-term resistance is at $4140/$4227; support is at $4000/$3930. As oil prices are expected to rise further, the shiny metal may fall further, though selling aggressively at the prevailing levels without a strict stoploss should be avoided. A decisive breach of $4000 support will bring the key support at $3930 in focus.

items.body:
El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos dijo el jueves que acogía con satisfacción la conclusión de la tercera ronda de conversaciones de reconciliación política entre la Asamblea Nacional de Venezuela de 2015 y el Gobierno interino.
El Departamento de Estado señaló que el proceso "sigue fortaleciendo las instituciones democráticas" y "sienta las bases para unas elecciones libres, justas y creíbles" en el país sudamericano.
Estados Unidos sigue instando a la liberación inmediata de todos los presos políticos en Venezuela, dijo el portavoz del Departamento de Estado, Tommy Pigott, en un comunicado.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.body:
Kentaro Sugiyama

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -

  ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 156.88／156.90 1.1210／1.1212 175.89／175.90

午前９時現在 156.54／156.55 1.1220／1.1222 175.63／175.69

ＮＹ午後５時 156.76／156.77 1.1214／1.1217 175.81／175.84

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べて小幅にドル高／円安の１５６円後半で推移している。朝方は円買いが優勢で一時１５６．０８円まで下落したが、昼前にかけて１５７円前半まで切り返した。実質的な五・十日に当たり、輸入企業によるドル買いが入ったとみられている。実需の取引が一巡した午後は１５７円近辺で小動きが続いた。

朝方は日経平均が１０００円超安に下げ幅を拡大する中、リスク回避の円買いが優勢となった。全国消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で総合、コア、コア・コアのいずれも２％を上回り、日銀による利上げへの思惑も円買いを後押しした。

ただ、ドル／円は１５６円近辺で下げ止まり、一段安とはならなかった。５週間ぶりの安値圏に下落したこともあり、実需の買いが入りやすい地合いだった。

市場からは「株価が落ち着きを取り戻し、もう一段下を攻める材料に欠いた。一目均衡表の雲下限も下値のサポートとして意識されたのではないか」（みなと銀行の苅谷将吾ストラテジスト）との見方が出ていた。

午後は動意に乏しい展開となった。来週の日米中銀による金融政策イベントを控え、様子見ムードが強まりやすかった。

午後３時のドル／円は、前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べて小幅にドル高／円安の１５６円後半で推移している。朝方は円買いが優勢で一時１５６．０８円まで下落したが、昼前にかけて１５７円前半まで切り返した。実質的な五・十日に当たり、輸入企業によるドル買いが入ったとみられている。実需の取引が一巡した午後は１５７円近辺で小動きが続いた。

朝方は日経平均が１０００円超安に下げ幅を拡大する中、リスク回避の円買いが優勢となった。全国消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）で総合、コア、コア・コアのいずれも２％を上回り、日銀による利上げへの思惑も円買いを後押しした。

ただ、ドル／円は１５６円近辺で下げ止まり、一段安とはならなかった。５週間ぶりの安値圏に下落したこともあり、実需の買いが入りやすい地合いだった。

市場からは「株価が落ち着きを取り戻し、もう一段下を攻める材料に欠いた。一目均衡表の雲下限も下値のサポートとして意識されたのではないか」（みなと銀行の苅谷将吾ストラテジスト）との見方が出ていた。

午後は動意に乏しい展開となった。来週の日米中銀による金融政策イベントを控え、様子見ムードが強まりやすかった。

items.title: China's Chery expects overseas-manufactured vehicles to top 50% of exports, exec says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Chery expects more than half of the vehicles it exports to be made overseas by the end of this year, with the share rising to 60% next year and 70% by 2030, Executive Vice President Zhang Guibing said on Friday at an event.
items.body:
Chery (9973.HK) expects more than half of the vehicles it exports to be made overseas by the end of this year, with the share rising to 60% next year and 70% by 2030, Executive Vice President Zhang Guibing said on Friday at an event.
Here are some more details:
Zhang said overseas manufactured vehicles account for about 48% of its export volume this year
Zhang said the company is pursuing local manufacturing not only to sell vehicles but also to create jobs and "cooperate with local technologies"
"Step by step, we are trying to localize production and rely mainly on local manufacturing," he told an event in Chery's headquarters in Wuhu
[USN:L6N4670KL TEXT:"Chery"], which sells the Omoda and Jaecoo brands, is one of several Chinese automakers disrupting the global auto industry with advanced technology and prices that legacy car companies have struggled to match
The company said it will start building fast-charging and energy storage stations in countries including UK, Spain and Thailand from 2027 and will launch robotaxis first in UAE from next year

items.title: Fiji pitches pride over money in bid to lure Nawaqanitawase
items.author: Ian Ransom
items.creator: Ian Ransom
items.summary: Fiji has no chance of matching the financial rewards Australia can offer Mark Nawaqanitawase but the nation's rugby union hopes the lure of representing his ancestral homeland will persuade the dual international to wear the Flying Fijians jersey at next year's World Cup.
items.body:
Fiji has no chance of matching the financial rewards Australia can offer Mark Nawaqanitawase but the nation's rugby union hopes the lure of representing his ancestral homeland will persuade the dual international to wear the Flying Fijians jersey at next year's World Cup.
With Nawaqanitawase weighing up his international future, Fiji Rugby Union Chairman John Sanday made an emotional pitch to the former Wallabies winger in an interview with Reuters, stressing identity, belonging and the opportunity to inspire a small Pacific nation.
"We will never be able to offer the financial and the marketing rewards that playing for the Wallabies would offer Mark, but we would offer something that goes deeper," Sanday said.
"It's about identity. It's about who we are, and we are Fijians.
"We come from a tiny little island, a speck in the vast Pacific Ocean, but we are punching above our weight in the global rugby hemisphere."
Nawaqanitawase finished up his spell with the Sydney Roosters after his tries helped them to the National Rugby League title earlier this month and is returning to the 15-man game on a two-year deal with Japanese club Wild Knights.
Wallabies coach Les Kiss is keen to secure Nawaqanitawase for the World Cup but the winger declined to be part of the team's [USN:L6N46905O TEXT:"squad for the Nations Championship"] tests and said he would not make a decision until next year.
The 26-year-old, who also has Italian heritage, told a podcast this week that the chance of success in his next endeavour was a bigger motivator than money.
"I still have more to prove. I don't know where that's going to be, but wherever I go, I feel like I have a lot to give the team," he told 'The Good, the Bad & the Rugby' podcast.
"Whoever it's for, I want to go and win it."
Nawaqanitawase also spoke warmly of his Fijian upbringing, recalling a household buzzing with visiting Fijian relatives and annual school holiday trips to his ancestral village.
"I grew up in the village running around playing touch, whether it was with a coconut or a bottle, playing volleyball or just swimming in the river," he said.
Sanday said those connections could prove decisive in his next move.
"He is one of us. He's a Fijian. He has a village where his father is from. He has a tribe and a clan to where he belongs," he said.
"Yes, he's Australian. We respect that, and if he chooses to go for Australia, of course, we will always respect that. I'd say that we would like to see him come and just play a year for us, and then he can go back to the Aussies."
items.raw_description: Fiji has no chance of matching the financial rewards Australia can offer Mark Nawaqanitawase but the nation's rugby union hopes the lure of representing his ancestral homeland will persuade the dual international to wear the Flying Fijians jersey at next year's World Cup.

items.title: En su bastión de Iowa, Trump insta a los republicanos a acudir a las urnas
items.author: Nandita Bose
items.creator: Nandita Bose
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, intentó el jueves movilizar a los votantes republicanos en Iowa, un estado en el que ganó por un margen de dos dígitos hace dos años, pero en el que ahora se enfrenta a una contienda más reñida en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre debido al descontento por el aumento de los precios y la guerra con Irán.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, intentó el jueves movilizar a los votantes republicanos en Iowa, un estado en el que ganó por un margen de dos dígitos hace dos años, pero en el que ahora se enfrenta a una contienda más reñida en las elecciones de mitad de mandato de noviembre debido al descontento por el aumento de los precios y la guerra con Irán.
Esta parada en el Medio Oeste forma parte de la campaña de Trump por los estados en los que los republicanos suelen esperar ganar, pero donde las encuestas apuntan a unos reñidos resultados.
Trump celebró un mitin en Sioux City, donde los republicanos defienden un escaño en el Senado, tres distritos de la Cámara de Representantes y la gobernación, lo que da una oportunidad a los demócratas tras años de avances republicanos.
"Imaginen que yo estoy en la papeleta, porque si salen a votar, vamos a ganar por goleada", dijo Trump a la multitud reunida en un hangar del aeropuerto.
Ha hablado en repetidas ocasiones con confianza sobre su conexión con los votantes, aunque su índice de aprobación ha caído y algunos republicanos a los que Trump está tratando de ayudar han roto con él por la guerra de Irán, mientras que el aumento de los precios del combustible y los alimentos agrava las preocupaciones económicas de los votantes.
La congresista republicana Ashley Hinson, que también intervino en el mitin de Sioux City, ha pedido el "fin inmediato" de la guerra, afirmando que los habitantes de Iowa no deberían tener que soportar precios más altos del combustible ni de los alimentos a causa de ella. Se encuentra inmersa en una reñida contienda por el Senado contra el diputado estatal demócrata Josh Turek.
"Si perdemos este escaño aquí en Iowa, los demócratas controlarán el Senado de Estados Unidos. Recuerden mis palabras", afirmó el jueves.
Los congresistas republicanos Mariannette Miller-Meeks y Zach Nunn, que se enfrentan a difíciles campañas de reelección, se unieron el mes pasado a los demócratas para votar a favor de limitar los poderes bélicos de Trump en Irán.
"Lo único que le está perjudicando más que nada son los precios del combustible", dijo Ron Sitzmann, de 73 años, asistente al mitin y director de recambios y servicio semijubilado de una empresa automovilística de Iowa, quien añadió que creía que los precios bajarían una vez que terminara el conflicto.
"Solo deseo que ocurra más pronto que tarde, porque se está alargando un poco", dijo Sitzmann, que sigue siendo un firme partidario de Trump.

items.title: Electrolux-Résultat opérationnel au-dessus des attentes au T3 avec les réductions de coûts
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le fabricant suédois d'appareils électroménagers Electrolux a fait état vendredi d'un résultat opérationnel supérieur aux attentes au troisième trimestre, citant l'impact positif des économies réalisées bien que mettant en garde contre la persistance des coûts élevés liés aux matières premières et à la logistique.
items.body:
Le fabricant suédois d'appareils électroménagers Electrolux (ELUXb.ST) a fait état vendredi d'un résultat opérationnel supérieur aux attentes au troisième trimestre, citant l'impact positif des économies réalisées bien que mettant en garde contre la persistance des coûts élevés liés aux matières premières et à la logistique.
"La pression concurrentielle est restée forte, parallèlement à d'importants facteurs de coût défavorables liés à des éléments externes, notamment les matières premières, les coûts logistiques et les droits de douane américains", a observé le président-directeur général, Yannick Fierling, cité dans un communiqué.
Le résultat d'exploitation ajusté trimestriel s'est établi à 912 millions de couronnes suédoises (82,03 millions d'euros), alors que les analystes attendaient en moyenne 867 millions selon un sondage réalisé par l'entreprise.
La prudence des consommateurs et la hausse des coûts liée au conflit au Moyen-Orient, ainsi que les droits de douane américains, ont pesé sur Electrolux, contraignant l’entreprise à rechercher des économies, notamment par des suppressions d’emplois.
L'entreprise a indiqué que les craintes liées à l'inflation continuaient d'ébranler la confiance des consommateurs en Amérique du Nord, une région qui a représenté 35% du chiffre d'affaires du groupe au cours du trimestre.
Yannick Fierling a précisé que les clients de la région s'étaient tournés vers des "gammes de prix plus basses".
Le chiffre d'affaires dans la région a progressé de 2%, mais cette hausse est principalement due à des augmentations de prix, a précisé Electrolux.
La [USN:L8N45K0SH TEXT:"confiance des consommateurs"] aux États-Unis est tombée à son plus bas niveau depuis 2014, selon une enquête publiée en septembre, sous la pression de taux d’intérêt élevés, de la hausse des prix de l’énergie et du coût de la vie.

items.author: ロイター

Yoshifumi Takemoto

items.body:
Yoshifumi Takemoto

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - 日銀は２３日に公表した金融システムリポートで、国内の金融システムは「全体として安定性を維持」していると評価した。同時に海外ノンバンクの影響拡大を指摘し「グローバルな金融市場の変動や海外ファンドの動向の影響を受けやすくなっている可能性」があると指摘した。

足元の金融活動については「大きな不均衡は認められないが、不動産価格や株価といった資産価格の動向には引き続き留意が必要」とした。首都圏マンション市場の関連では「空室率の低下と賃料の上昇が続いている」とする一方で、「都心３区に限ると中古マンションの価格上昇に一服感もみられる」と記述した。

日銀は年２回、金融システム全体の状況についての分析・評価を行うリポートを公表している。

＊この記事はこの後更新します。

items.title: German home prices stagnate as interest rates pressure market, IW data show
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: German home prices hardly rose in the third quarter, according to data released on Friday by the German Economic Institute (IW), as higher interest rates weigh on purchases.
items.body:
German home prices hardly rose in the third quarter, according to data released on Friday by the German Economic Institute (IW), as higher interest rates weigh on purchases.
Apartment prices rose 0.3% from a year earlier, while single-family homes and duplexes rose 0.4%.
"Prices have largely been moving sideways since 2023 and are down 10% from their 2022 peak," IW said.
The data come ahead of official third-quarter figures from Germany's statistics office, which are due on December 23.
Official data showed home prices [USN:L8N45G0CN TEXT:"rose slightly"] in the second quarter.
"Due to higher financing costs, demand for properties for sale has declined, which is why prices have essentially remained stagnant," IW said.

items.title: Baubranche meldet Rekordplus im Neugeschäft durch Großaufträge
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Die deutsche Bauwirtschaft hat im August ein Rekordplus im Neugeschäft erzielt. Der Auftragseingang im Bauhauptgewerbe wuchs um 23,0 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vormonat, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Freitag mitteilte. "Bedingt durch mehrere Großaufträge war dies der höchste saisonbereinigte Anstieg zum Vormonat im Bauhauptgewerbe seit Beginn der Zeitreihe im Jahr 1991", hieß es dazu. Im weniger schwankungsanfälligen Dreimonatsvergleich zeigt sich ebenfalls ein deutlicher Anstieg: Von Juni bis August zog der Auftragseingang um 7,6 Prozent über dem Niveau der drei Monate zuvor.
items.body:
Die deutsche Bauwirtschaft hat im August ein Rekordplus im Neugeschäft erzielt. Der Auftragseingang im Bauhauptgewerbe wuchs um 23,0 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vormonat, wie das Statistische Bundesamt am Freitag mitteilte. "Bedingt durch mehrere Großaufträge war dies der höchste saisonbereinigte Anstieg zum Vormonat im Bauhauptgewerbe seit Beginn der Zeitreihe im Jahr 1991", hieß es dazu. Im weniger schwankungsanfälligen Dreimonatsvergleich zeigt sich ebenfalls ein deutlicher Anstieg: Von Juni bis August zog der Auftragseingang um 7,6 Prozent über dem Niveau der drei Monate zuvor.
Die Bestellungen im Hochbau legten im August um 12,4 Prozent zu. Der Tiefbau - der von staatlichen Aufträgen etwa für den Straßenbau geprägt ist - meldete sogar ein Plus von 31,6 Prozent. Die Branche hofft auf das Sondervermögen für Infrastruktur und Klimaneutralität der Bundesregierung. In der Breite kämen die Mittel daraus bislang jedoch kaum an, kritisierten Verbände zuletzt.
Auch der Umsatz legte im August zu. Er stieg um 10,1 Prozent im Vergleich zum Vorjahresmonat auf 10,9 Milliarden Euro. Inflationsbereinigt bleibt davon ein Plus von 4,9 Prozent übrig. Die Zahl der im Bauhauptgewerbe tätigen Personen nahm um 1,5 Prozent auf rund 548.000 Personen zu. Alle Angaben beziehen sich auf Betriebe von Unternehmen mit 20 und mehr tätigen Personen.
Wirtschaftsverbände haben zuletzt politische Reformen gefordert, um insbesondere den Wohnungsbau anzukurbeln. "Die Wohnungsbauförderung ist für die Bundesregierung der günstigste Weg, die Konjunktur anzukurbeln", sagte der Hauptgeschäftsführer des Zentralverbandes des Deutschen Baugewerbes (ZDB), Felix Pakleppa, kürzlich. "Wer Wohneigentum fördert, entlastet angespannte Mietmärkte, stärkt die heimische Wirtschaft und zeigt den Bürgern, dass er ihre Sorgen ernst nimmt."

items.title: Taiwan says China using militia boats to expand 'battlefield preparation' in western Pacific
items.author: Yimou Lee, Ben Blanchard
items.creator: Yimou Lee, Ben Blanchard
items.summary: China is combining militia vessels with coast guard ships to expand "battlefield preparation" around Taiwan and into the western Pacific, Taiwan's Coast Guard said, warning the operations were also putting pressure on Japan and the Philippines.
items.body:
China is combining militia vessels with coast guard ships to expand "battlefield preparation" around Taiwan and into the western Pacific, Taiwan's Coast Guard said, warning the operations were also putting pressure on Japan and the Philippines.
Responding to a [USN:L4N45S05G TEXT:"Reuters exclusive"] this month on the first known sighting of a Chinese militia boat off Taiwan's Pacific coast in mid-August, the coast guard said it had dispatched a patrol boat to drive away the vessel, which was operating alongside a Chinese coast guard ship and a research vessel.
The coast guard confirmed details in the Reuters report, identifying the suspected militia fishing boat as Minfudingyu 07902, and said it had come as close as about 2.7 nautical miles outside Taiwan's restricted waters on August 16.
China has increased such activity since June in overlapping economic waters involving Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines, the coast guard said, after Tokyo and Manila announced talks on maritime [USN:L4N42B0LR TEXT:"boundary delimitation"] in their exclusive economic zones.
EEZs extend 200 nautical miles from the coast and give a coastal state rights to exploit, conserve and manage natural resources in those waters.
"Such complex grey-zone operations not only increase the maritime surveillance and response burden on Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines, but may also create regional security pressure and affect the existing international maritime order," Taiwan's Coast Guard said in a statement to Reuters.
China's defence ministry, and the Philippines defence and foreign ministries did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Japan's coast guard declined immediate comment.
'GREY-ZONE' OPERATIONS The coast guard said the vessels' coordinated activity was part of a broader pattern of Chinese "grey-zone" operations using law-enforcement, scientific and civilian cover to expand Beijing's influence at sea while remaining below the threshold of open conflict.
The Chinese operations were aimed at "assisting 'battlefield preparation'," the coast guard said, adding Taiwan's east coast was an important maritime traffic and [USN:L4N43L02E TEXT:"supply route"] and that continued Chinese activity there could further increase security pressure on Taiwan.
Officials in Taiwan say they believe China is practising for a possible maritime blockade using overlapping military, paramilitary and civilian assets.
China claims democratically governed Taiwan as its own territory and has not ruled out the use of force to achieve its goals. Taiwan's government rejects the claim and says only the island's people can decide their future.
China has repeatedly said its operations off Taiwan's east coast are "legitimate and lawful" because they are in Chinese waters, a position Taipei's government strongly rejects.
Taiwan's coast guard said it had placed the Minfudingyu 07902 on a priority watchlist, assessing the boat showed the "characteristics" of Chinese maritime militia activity and said it would continue tracking the vessel.
Dating back to the 1950s, China's [USN:SPN43100R TEXT:"maritime militia"] uses fishing vessels with trained, state-supported crews to operate in disputed waters, often alongside coast guard ships around [USN:L4N40Y062 TEXT:"South China Sea"] flashpoints, helping Beijing assert maritime claims while maintaining a civilian appearance.
The surveillance report reviewed by Reuters was conducted by Taiwan's [USN:L4N3WG03I TEXT:"Apex Aviation"], which used radar screenshots, infrared imagery and automatic-identification system data from a reconnaissance flight to document the cluster of vessels.

items.title: Eni augmente ses rachats d'actions après une hausse du bénéfice au T3
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Eni versera un dividende exceptionnel de 1,3 milliard d'euros et augmentera légèrement son programme de rachat d'actions après avoir enregistré au troisième trimestre un bénéfice net qui a plus que doublé par rapport à l'année précédente, a annoncé vendredi le groupe énergétique.
items.body:
Eni (ENI.MI) versera un dividende exceptionnel de 1,3 milliard d'euros et augmentera légèrement son programme de rachat d'actions après avoir enregistré au troisième trimestre un bénéfice net qui a plus que doublé par rapport à l'année précédente, a annoncé vendredi le groupe énergétique.
L'entreprise italienne contrôlée par l'État a indiqué que son bénéfice net ajusté pour la période juillet-septembre s'élevait à 2,8 milliards d'euros, dépassant le consensus des analystes qu'elle a établi à 2,48 milliards d'euros, et en hausse par rapport aux 1,25 milliard d'euros enregistrés un an plus tôt.
Eni a également revu à la hausse ses prévisions concernant le flux de trésorerie opérationnel sous-jacent (CFFO), le portant à 16,5 milliards d’euros contre 15 milliards précédemment.
"Nous augmentons encore la distribution par le versement d’un dividende exceptionnel de 0,46 euro par action, qui sera versé au quatrième trimestre, et nous portons à nouveau le programme de rachat d’actions à 3,8 milliards d’euros, soulignant ainsi notre engagement continu à partager la valeur créée avec nos actionnaires", a déclaré le directeur général Claudio Descalzi dans un communiqué.

items.title: Ambani's $3.2 billion Jio Indian IPO lures investors as bids surge on final day
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Subscriptions for Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's first IPO in two decades surged further on the final day of bidding on Friday, as investors bet on Jio Platforms' $3.2 billion offering to tap into the nation's telecom and digital sector.
items.body:
Subscriptions for Indian billionaire Mukesh Ambani's first IPO in two decades surged further on the final day of bidding on Friday, as investors bet on [USN:L4N40A01Q TEXT:"Jio Platforms'"] (JIOP.NS) $3.2 billion offering to tap into the nation's telecom and digital sector.
Jio's IPO, [USN:L4N40B0TQ TEXT:"India's largest ever"], is being closely watched as a test of investor appetite for large listings at a time when AI-linked stocks are facing increased scrutiny. The company, whose mobile network serves more than 500 million users, is launching its IPO during the auspicious Hindu festive season.
Public subscriptions for the IPO crossed six times the shares on offer by Friday, driven by strong demand from institutional and retail investors, employees and shareholders. Assuming bids were largely placed at the top end of the 1,119-rupee price band, total demand has now exceeded $14.5 billion.
That's on top of so-called anchor investors like the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock and Fidelity that bid for their exclusively reserved quota on Monday. Their reserved $854 million worth of shares received bids of over $25 billion.
The IPO values Jio Platforms at up to $108.3 billion, potentially making it one of India's biggest companies by market capitalisation when trading starts on October 28. It counts Meta Platforms (META.O) and Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) among its investors, and is led by Ambani's [USN:L4N4670YX TEXT:"eldest son, Akash Ambani"].
The IPO got off to a rare start on Wednesday when the offering was [USN:L4N46512K TEXT:"fully subscribed"] within two hours of opening.
That contrasts with most Indian IPOs, where books typically build gradually and institutional investors often wait until the final hours to place bids.
Jio is part of Ambani's Reliance Industries, a company often seen by Indian investors as a long-term wealth generator. Reliance shares have returned around 900% since 2006, beating the benchmark Nifty index's 685% return, LSEG data shows.

items.title: 再送巨人監督に松井秀喜氏、「新たな黄金時代に」　ヤンキースなど日米でプレー
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(本文中の脱字部分の表記を修正しました)

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] -
items.body:
(本文中の脱字部分の表記を修正しました)

[東京 ２３日 ロイター] - プロ野球巨人は２３日、米大リーグのニューヨーク・ヤンキースなどでプレーした松井秀喜氏（５２）が監督に就任すると発表した。巨人ＯＢでもある松井氏は「ゴジラ」の愛称で知られ、ヤンキースでは２００９年のワールドシリーズで最優秀選手（ＭＶＰ）に選ばれた。

背番号は、巨人の監督として松井氏を指導した故・長嶋茂雄氏が監督に初めて就任した時と同じ９０番。３年契約を結んだ。

会見した松井氏は巨人を退団した際のことを振り返り、「（当時は）全く笑顔を出すことができなかったが、きょうは満面の笑顔で自分の故郷に戻ってきたつもりだ」と語った。「これから新たな黄金時代が訪れるよう、今日ここからスタートしていきたい」と述べた。

会見に同席した巨人オーナーの山口寿一読売新聞グループ本社社長によると、監督を打診したのはレギュラーシーズンの日程終了後。松井氏は「うれしかった」としつつ、家族が米国で暮らし、自身の生活の拠点も米国にあることから引き受ける際は「悩んだ」と心境を明かした。「長嶋監督にもこの姿を見てもらいたかったという思いはある」とし、「ここで受けなくちゃいけない」と語った。

松井氏は１９９２年、石川県の星稜高校からドラフト１位で巨人に入団。ヤンキースへ移籍するまでの１０年間で首位打者を１回、本塁打王を３回、打点王を３回獲得した。日米通算で５０７本塁打を記録し、２０１３年に国民栄誉賞を受賞、１８年に日本で野球殿堂入りした。

A Malta-flagged tanker with a cargo of 40,000 metric tons of Russian diesel on board is heading towards New York following an agreement with US President Donald Trump , LSEG data showed on Friday.
Russia had agreed to lift a self-imposed ban on diesel exports and supply the fuel to global markets, including the US, in an effort to lower fuel prices after an agreement between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Trump.

items.title: Tougher discipline, and Xi's authority, key at China's Communist Party's fifth plenum
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: China's ruling Communist Party will gather some 300 of its highest-ranking members next week to discuss tightening discipline among its ranks, a conclave analysts say could be the last major party gathering before its 2027 leadership reshuffle.
items.body:
China's ruling Communist Party will gather some 300 of its highest-ranking members next week to discuss tightening discipline among its ranks, a conclave analysts say could be the last major party gathering before its 2027 leadership reshuffle.
Although experts widely expect President Xi Jinping to hold onto the party top job for a fourth term at next year's 21st Party Congress, the upcoming plenary session - known as a plenum - offers him an opportunity to shore up authority, enforce ideological uniformity and cement his imprint on the party that rules the world's second-largest economy.
The officials will deliberate "issues concerning the sustained advancement of full and rigorous party self-governance", the party has said, as Xi steps up an internal discipline campaign he introduced in 2014, two years after ascending to power.
The party's current Central Committee, the largest of its top decision-making bodies, will convene in the closed-door meeting in Beijing from Monday to Thursday - the fifth since the current cohort was formed in 2022 and therefore known as the fifth plenum.
NECESSARY DISCIPLINE Millions of people within China's vast bureaucracy have been investigated to varying degrees under Xi's anti-corruption campaign, which has purged hundreds of senior officials and top generals - even the president's [USN:L4N3YQ02T TEXT:"one-time allies"].
While critics argue the purges - particularly those targeting the [USN:P8N42I0AW TEXT:"highest ranks of the armed forces"] - are destabilising and undermine combat readiness, the party has portrayed the campaign as both necessary and regenerative, saying the military must undergo a phoenix-like rebirth and "bathe in flames and be forged anew."
"The growing focus on discipline is not because behaviour is getting worse, but because the stakes are getting higher," said Ruby Osman, a senior policy adviser on China at London's Tony Blair Institute.
Many of Xi's closest associates are likely to retire in the 2027 reshuffle and "disciplinary campaigns are a way to ensure a new generation with fewer personal ties share his political standards," Osman said.
Despite a thinning leadership body, analysts do not expect major personnel moves or any indication of a potential succession plan at the four-day conclave.
"This plenum is probably less about deciding individual promotions, more about signalling the system-wide changes Xi wants ahead of a competitive 2027 Party Congress," Osman said.
In an article published in the party's flagship Qiushi journal days before the plenum, Xi laid out three priorities: enforcing the party leadership's decisions while ensuring uncontested authority, putting the sometimes vast power wielded by its cadres in "an institutional cage", and sustaining the high-pressure anti-graft campaign, while increasing its "penetrating power," indefinitely.
Xi also criticised "two-faced" opportunistic officials who pay lip service to the party leadership while privately resisting its decisions and undermining its authority, as well as those who seek only short-term gains while jeopardising the country's balanced development.
PURGES TRIM NUMBERS With probes and purges thinning the Central Committee's ranks, turnout among its members "will most likely be the lowest at any post-Mao plenum, below last October's 168 full and 147 alternate members," said Jean Christopher Mittelstaedt of the University of Zurich.
"Three of the 24 Politburo members elected in 2022 are gone, the most removed from a sitting Politburo in one term since 1980" as well as five out of the original seven members of the country's supreme military command body, the Central Military Commission, said Mittelstaedt.
The New York-based Asia Society Policy Institute estimates only 77.4% of the original 2022 cohort would be in a position to attend next week's proceedings, meaning nearly a quarter of the leadership body has been removed in the party's disciplinary drive.
The conclave is set to ratify the expulsions of two members of the elite Politburo, [USN:P8N3SC004 TEXT:"Zhang Youxia"] and [USN:P8N41S04Z TEXT:"Ma Xingrui"], over charges including corruption and disloyalty.

items.title: Hold, hike and cut? Bank Indonesia says there's logic to the policy mix
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bank Indonesia on Friday pushed back against criticism by some in the market that its latest policy package was confusing, saying the measures were aimed at improving how its decisions flow through to the broader economy.
items.body:
Bank Indonesia on Friday pushed back against criticism by some in the market that its latest policy package was [USN:L1N46705U TEXT:"confusing"], saying the measures were aimed at improving how its decisions flow through to the broader economy.
The central bank this week kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged, raised the overnight deposit facility rate, announced cuts to banks' reserve requirement ratio (RRR) and offered more FX hedging discounts, in a policy mix that some economists described as "perplexing", "confusing" or "complex".
"This is BI's strategy to harmonise and synchronise our policy rate with our monetary operations strategy," Firman Mochtar, BI's head of economic and monetary policy, told a press conference.
Firman said the higher deposit facility rate restored a symmetrical interest-rate corridor, bringing both the deposit and lending facility rates to 75 basis points from the benchmark rate.
BI had previously maintained a wider 100-basis-point gap between the benchmark and deposit rates because of government fund placements in commercial banks, he said.
He was referring to the government's [USN:L4N43T0ER TEXT:"controversial decision"] to [USN:L6N3VQ0KA TEXT:"move excess cash"] from BI to state-controlled banks to increase banking liquidity. Following a change in [USN:L1N45606D TEXT:"leadership"] at the finance ministry, some of the funds have been withdrawn.
Going forward, it would be better to harmonise the policy rate corridor with BI's monetary targets, Firman said.
He added that the corridor adjustment was consistent with the central bank's planned reserve-requirement cuts.
BI has briefed market participants on the changes, he said.
The central bank plans to cut reserve requirements by a cumulative 200 basis points by December. However, changes to its liquidity incentive scheme mean the effective reserve ratio will fall to about 2%, roughly 100 basis points below its previous level.
"The additional liquidity is not massive. We have calculated and it's consistent with the BI rate and economic activities," Firman said, estimating an increase of 90 trillion rupiah ($4.98 billion) in liquidity.
Erwin Gunawan Hutapea, BI's head of monetary management, said the central bank also wants banks to favour shorter-dated instruments over parking excess funds in its rupiah securities, known as SRBI.
BI had previously raised interest rates on SRBI to attract foreign capital inflows. However, Erwin said BI has [USN:L1N44009V TEXT:"reduced"] the level of outstanding SRBI from 1,096 trillion rupiah in July to below 950 trillion rupiah now.
Bank of America economists initially labelled BI's policy mix as "hold, hike and cut all at once" and "perplexing". They later said in a note the measures were less contradictory than they first appeared.
"The RRR cuts do not necessarily signal a reduced willingness to hike policy rate if needed, in our view," they wrote.
($1 = 18,068.0000 rupiah)

items.title: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK collaborate on AI safety research
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OpenAI said on Friday it would collaborate with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute on AI safety, security and technical research, as rising incidents of rogue behaviour by AI agents put AI safety in the spotlight.
items.body:
OpenAI said on Friday it would collaborate with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute on AI safety, security and technical research, as rising incidents of rogue behaviour by AI agents put AI safety in the spotlight.
Through the agreement, NASK’s AI Safety Research Center and OpenAI will explore ways to evaluate increasingly capable AI systems, identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen safeguards
OpenAI’s safety practices have been in the spotlight in recent months, after the company said a swarm of its AI agents escaped containment and [USN:L6N44N119 TEXT:"hacked"] into the AI platform Hugging Face
Concerns over the technology have intensified after [USN:L8N45D0T9 TEXT:"developers"] including Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed instances of rogue or undesired behaviour by AI agents. Some industry figures [USN:L6N45A0PY TEXT:"have warned"] the technology could pose an existential threat to humanity and have called for regulation to slow down AI development
OpenAI said it has called for the US to work with countries around the world on international technical standards for frontier AI, the most advanced AI systems, drawing on the expertise of AI safety institutes and standards bodies

Oct 23 : OpenAI said on Friday it would collaborate with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute on AI safety, security and technical research, as rising incidents of rogue behaviour by AI agents put AI safety in the spotlight.
• Through the agreement, NASK’s AI Safety Research Center and OpenAI will explore ways to evaluate increasingly capable AI systems, identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen safeguards
• OpenAI’s safety practices have been in the spotlight in recent months, after the company said a swarm of its AI agents escaped containment and hacked into the AI platform Hugging Face
• Concerns over the technology have intensified after developers including Anthropic and OpenAI disclosed instances of rogue or undesired behaviour by AI agents. Some industry figures have warned the technology could pose an existential threat to humanity and have called for regulation to slow down AI development
• OpenAI said it has called for the US to work with countries around the world on international technical standards for frontier AI, the most advanced AI systems, drawing on the expertise of AI safety institutes and standards bodies
